newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to auction 150 bln dong T-notes Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to auction 150 bln dong T-notes Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 150 billion dong ($12.83 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on July 30, the central bank sold 81.6 billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes to domestic institutions at an annual interest rate of 11.3 percent.
The government has held 19 Treasury paper auctions so far this year, through which a total of 1,267.6 billion dong worth of Treasury stock has been issued.
